line.elder.king.label: Where did they take the king?

line.elder.advice.label: I could use a little advice.

voice.innkeeper.prompt: Warm fantasy storytelling voice for Mara.

line.innkeeper.dreamcap.label: How do I get past an orc guard?

line.innkeeper.buy.label: Do you have any honey stout?

line.innkeeper.goodbye.label: Keep a seat by the fire for us.

voice.miner.prompt: Warm fantasy storytelling voice for Orrin.

line.miner.password.label: The king needs us. How do I open the chest?

voice.chest.prompt: Warm fantasy storytelling voice for The runed chest.

line.chest-locked.guess.label: Chest Locked · …where I left my keys?

line.elder.greeting.prompt: Borin. You have your father’s stubborn look. Good. We will need it.

voiceSettings.text: Borin. You have your father’s stubborn look. Good. We will need it.

line.elder.king.prompt: East, through the wood. Aldric’s cage is above a ledge in the orc camp. Take a rope, and find a way to open the lock.

voiceSettings.text: East, through the wood. Aldric’s cage is above a ledge in the orc camp. Take a rope, and find a way to open the lock.

line.elder.advice.prompt: Visit your cottage for supplies. Then speak to Mara and Orrin at the Copper Tankard. A conversation opens more doors than an axe.

voiceSettings.text: Visit your cottage for supplies. Then speak to Mara and Orrin at the Copper Tankard. A conversation opens more doors than an axe.

line.innkeeper.greeting.prompt: If you are planning a rescue, I hope you are planning to come back for supper.

voiceSettings.text: If you are planning a rescue, I hope you are planning to come back for supper.

line.innkeeper.dreamcap.prompt: Orcs love honey stout. Add a silver-spotted dreamcap from the wood and they will sleep for hours. Combine them in your satchel, then slip the brew into their stew when the guard looks away.

voiceSettings.text: Orcs love honey stout. Add a silver-spotted dreamcap from the wood and they will sleep for hours. Combine them in your satchel, then slip the brew into their stew when the guard looks away.

line.innkeeper.buy.prompt: One copper coin. Bring me one from home, select it in your satchel, and hand it over. This is a pub, not a charity for heroes.

voiceSettings.text: One copper coin. Bring me one from home, select it in your satchel, and hand it over. This is a pub, not a charity for heroes.

line.innkeeper.goodbye.prompt: Two seats. And something better than orc stew.

voiceSettings.text: Two seats. And something better than orc stew.

line.miner.greeting.prompt: My pickaxe is locked in the runed chest at Goldroot. Can’t be too careful with good steel.

voiceSettings.text: My pickaxe is locked in the runed chest at Goldroot. Can’t be too careful with good steel.

line.miner.password.prompt: For the king? Of course. When the chest asks its question, say: “Stone remembers.” Take the pickaxe. It will break an orc lock.

voiceSettings.text: For the king? Of course. When the chest asks its question, say: “Stone remembers.” Take the pickaxe. It will break an orc lock.

line.miner.mining.prompt: Enough to pay Mara. So, no.

voiceSettings.text: Enough to pay Mara. So, no.

line.miner.goodbye.prompt: Bring the king back first. The pickaxe can wait.

voiceSettings.text: Bring the king back first. The pickaxe can wait.

line.chest-locked.guess.prompt: THE CHEST REMAINS UNIMPRESSED. Perhaps Orrin at the pub knows the words.

background.forest-wide.prompt: A continuous 3:1 pixel-art panorama of the Whispering Wood. Ancient mossy trees frame a broad walkable forest path, with violet dreamcaps at the left roots, a timbered gold mine in the left quarter, an old oak and unlettered signpost in the middle, and an orc palisade gate at the far right. Match the Bramblehollow style reference. No characters, UI or lettering. See docs/art-prompts.md for the full production prompt.

original.name: original
original.prompt: Horizontally extended Whispering Wood panorama; full prompt in docs/art-prompts.md.

styleGuide.prompt: Match the Bramblehollow reference: richly detailed, blocky pixel art for a classic point-and-click fantasy adventure. Use crisp, visible pixel clusters; deep blue-green forest shadows, mossy greens, warm earthy stone and timber, and amber lantern and window light. Weathered dwarf cottages nestle among ancient trees, roots, moss and mushrooms. Maintain the reference's coherent lighting, textured materials, readable silhouettes and layered woodland depth. Adapt these qualities to each requested room, character or object while keeping its required framing and transparency.
